name: Echomnesia
detailed_description:
In the mysterious sci-fi visual novel "Echomnesia", two brilliant scientists - Morpheus and Crona, experiment with a suspicious Cube, but something goes wrong.

In their research, they discover a mysterious interaction between memory and entropy emission, revealing new facets of the human psyche and the potential for transcendental knowledge.

However, their experiments have unexpected consequences, and Morpheus and Crona must face their own past when the boundaries between reality and fantasy begin to blur. In this virtual labyrinth of memories and delusions, they discover that the most mysterious thing is human memory itself.

Will the heroes be able to finish this research without losing themselves and each other? And do they want to remain who they were in the beginning of this journey?

Features

  • A dark world where you can’t trust your thoughts or memories

  • A dual-axis narrative that will ensure the need to replay the linear story for full understanding

  • The mystery and tragedy of the situation: "The last message" that you have to learn and understand
